messages_addressing_check.name: messages_addressing_check
messages_addressing_check.value:
(
        ("messages"."addressing_mode" = 'agent' and "messages"."recipient_agent_id" is not null and "messages"."recipient_department_id" is null)
        or
        ("messages"."addressing_mode" = 'department' and "messages"."recipient_department_id" is not null and "messages"."recipient_agent_id" is null)
      )

memories_scope_owner_check.name: memories_scope_owner_check
memories_scope_owner_check.value: ("memories"."scope" = 'agent' and "memories"."owner_agent_id" is not null and "memories"."department_id" is not null) or ("memories"."scope" = 'department' and "memories"."owner_agent_id" is null and "memories"."department_id" is not null) or ("memories"."scope" = 'colony' and "memories"."owner_agent_id" is null and "memories"."department_id" is null)
